title: OneMinutePlease
description: Play Minecraft for only 1 minute a day! A 60-second timer appears when you join. When it hits zero, the datapack stops the server. The goal? Log in daily and beat the Ender Dragon—one minute at a time. Inspired by a viral TikTok challenge.
body:
📦 How It Works – 1 Minute a Day Datapack

This datapack limits your Minecraft gameplay to just 1 minute per day.
As soon as a player joins the world, a 60-second timer appears at the bottom of the screen. The countdown begins immediately.
Once the timer reaches 0, the datapack automatically shuts down the server, forcing all players to disconnect.

The idea is simple but challenging: log in every day, use your time wisely, and eventually defeat the Ender Dragon—one minute at a time.

 
⚙️ How to Set It Up (IMPORTANT)

To ensure the datapack works correctly, you must install it on a server. Here's how:
Place the datapack in the datapacks folder of your world.
Open the file 
```
server.properties
```
Find the line:
     
    permission-level=1
And change it to:
     
    permission-level=4
This grants the datapack the required permissions to execute server stop commands
Restart the server to apply changes.
